answer: I would anchor trust in Conferred yoga instructor certification with yoga association attestation. With a certification the association renews after assessed classes, a single hollow check quietly prices out anyone trying to run a hundred names at once. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the inlet compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the plume of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
